mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity ( user_id,schedule_id, day, place, start_time, end_time, description ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{scheduleId}, #{day}, #{place}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{description} )
mapper.select: SELECT activity_id, schedule_id, user_id, place, description, start_time, end_time, day FROM activity WHERE -- 1. 匹配行程主键 ID schedule_id = #{schedule.scheduleId} AND -- 2. 匹配用户 ID user_id = #{schedule.userId} AND -- 3. 匹配行程中的天数 day = #{day} ORDER BY -- 4. 按照开始时间顺序排列 (升序) start_time ASC
